Compatible with the manufacturer's Predator-series ground control infrastructure

The manufacturer dates Predator C Avenger's first flight to April 2009 and Avenger ER's first flight to October 2016, followed by an expanded flight test program in 2017. The ER configuration is the represented model.
The current production version has a 76 ft wingspan and over 20 hours of endurance; the ER data sheet lists a 44 ft length and 18,900 lb maximum gross takeoff weight.

The ER data sheet lists 9,000 lb payload capacity split into 3,000 lb internal and 6,000 lb external stores, an 860 lb forward bay and six external hardpoints. These are capacity ratings, not simultaneous loads or confirmed mission fits.
The aircraft uses a Pratt & Whitney PW545B turbofan with over 5,000 lb thrust, a runway requirement under 5,000 ft, 400 KTAS maximum airspeed and 50,000 ft maximum altitude.

GA-ASI reports MQ-20 Avenger autonomy demonstrations including multi-platform passive sensing, digital twins and human-machine teaming. These are company test milestones, not independent operational certification.

The buyandrentrobots listing describes Avenger as an available Shield AI service with quote-based pricing. It names an MQ-20 test airframe and does not establish a delivered fleet, a price or equivalence to every GA-ASI production configuration.

companyFocus.name: General Atomics Aeronautical Systems
highlights: GA-ASI describes itself as a world leader in unmanned aircraft systems and says its Predator series is the only one to surpass 9 million flight hours. These are company claims, not independent market-share data.

The Predator-series timeline distinguishes Predator C Avenger's April 2009 first flight, Avenger ER's October 2016 first flight and the 2017 expanded flight test program. The ER version is a configuration of the Avenger family.

The Avenger ER data sheet lists a 76 ft wingspan, 44 ft length, 18,900 lb maximum gross takeoff weight, 9,000 lb payload capacity and 20 hours maximum endurance. Payload is split into internal and external stores and is not a simultaneous-load guarantee.
The PW545B turbofan, 400 KTAS maximum airspeed, 50,000 ft maximum altitude and under-5,000-ft runway requirement are manufacturer specifications for the ER configuration.

MQ-20 Avenger autonomy work with Shield AI and other partners is described as demonstration and test activity. The directory's Shield AI service listing does not prove delivered production aircraft, pricing or equivalence to every GA-ASI configuration.
